reviewSamples.author: Sandy Wheeler
reviewSamples.text: I'm so happy I found Miami Woodwork Fine Carpentry. I have been needing a new wood mail box for a while and could not find anyone who did this work. I not only found someone I found an excellent craftsman. The work was done beautifully and quickly. I can't believe how lucky I am.

reviewSamples.author: Sandalio Perez
reviewSamples.text: Excellent and creative carpentry. Roilan is very professional and dependable and completed all the work in a very short time. He went above and beyond the contracted work to make sure everything met and exceeded expectations. The work was very reasonably priced, and he presented the receipts for the materials provided.

reviewSamples.author: Marta Fuentes
reviewSamples.text: It was a pleasure dealing with Roilán. He takes pride in a job well done, he is respectful, punctual, cleans up after his work and his prices are fair.

reviewSamples.author: Karina G.
reviewSamples.text: We had the absolute best experience working with Roilan to build a custom farmstand, and it turned out even better than we imagined! The craftsmanship is beautiful, sturdy, and full of thoughtful details that really make it stand out. You …
